name: Soybean Farming
notes:
Updated the soybean farming chemical inventory data (N, P2O5, and K2O fertilizers, herbicide, and insecticide) based on USDA NASS for years 2023 to 2050.
The chemical inventory data values corresponds to the five-year average from 2018 to 2023, as reported by the USDA NASS (https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/). Soybean farming yield data for 2023 uses the five-year average from 2018 to 2023. Soybean farming yield data for 2025 and 2030 uses the agricultural projections reported by USDA (https://www.ers.usda.gov/webdocs/outlooks/100526/oce-2021-1.pdf?v=2992.9). Soybean farming yield data for 2035 to 2050 are assumed similar to yield for 2030.
Since the per acre energy use data are preliminary, they are not updated in R&D GREET 2023. However, since the soybean yield is updated, the per bushel energy use value changes as well.
